assets.prompt: Create one isolated high-resolution 2D game projectile sprite, a faithful base-body candidate for the original Half-Life MP5-launched grenade. Use the attached two orthographic inspection views of the actual Uplink grenade.mdl mesh as the visual authority. Preserve its simple squat low-poly cylindrical shape, olive-grey weathered body, wide red band near the flat rear, a tapered shoulder at the front ending in a smaller red band, and the small dark grey concentric metal front cap. Preserve these unusual original game proportions, about two lengths per one diameter; do not substitute a generic modern round or the pickup ammo bundle. One horizontal grenade body pointing right, in the slight three-quarter view of the second reference so its small front cap is visible. Render as a crisp game cutout with source-faithful faceted volume and restrained refined texture, no new labels or added mechanical pieces. Entire object centered with generous transparent margins on every side. True alpha-transparent background, no floor, shadow, smoke, flame, motion trail, impact or scene. One body only, one static state, no sprite sheet or multiple views.
assets.qa_notes: Géométrie facettée, bandes rouges, corps olive-gris et capuchon concentrique correspondent à la vue calculée du modèle Uplink. Le rendu agrandit/réinterprète la texture et le relief du capuchon; les proportions semblent légèrement allongées par la perspective. Détourage lisible sur blanc/noir, marges amples autour de la silhouette utile; très faibles résidus alpha hors silhouette. Candidate d’étude Uplink : aucune identité binaire retail ni fidélité 1:1 déclarée.

assets.prompt: Create one isolated 2D game impact-decal candidate faithfully based on the supplied original Half-Life Uplink {SPIT1 texture preview. Reproduce just this one flat yellow-green Bullsquid contact stain: the irregular central blot, its broad rightward arm, diagonal lower-left streak, broader lower-right lobe, small upper-left round lobe and the few detached tiny droplets exactly where the reference shows them. Use the original yellow-green hue near RGB 204,228,40 with varying translucency; the dark-looking parts of the reference are lower alpha, not black paint. Preserve the distinctive asymmetric silhouette and diffuse opacity pattern. Translate the 32x32 reference into a clean higher-resolution game decal with gently smoothed edges, restrained detail and no glossy invented liquid beads. Front-facing flat decal, centered with wide fully transparent margins. True alpha-transparent background; all empty spaces must be transparent. assets.prompt: Create one isolated high-resolution 2D energy-sprite body candidate matching the supplied exit1.spr frame used as the Displacer ball's underlying body resource in Half-Life: Opposing Force. assets.prompt: Create one isolated 2D game VFX cloud component based closely on the attached original ballsmoke.spr first frame. This is a static candidate for one green cloud of the Gene Worm spit in Half-Life: Opposing Force. Preserve the source frame's small irregular roughly round billowing smoke shape, broken into a few soft uneven lobes, with the brighter curled billow at the upper left/top and a dimmer fragmented lower area with dark openings. Apply the documented green render tint RGB 0,255,0 to the original grayscale intensity pattern; retain its dim soft translucency and do not add white or yellow lighting. This must remain a compact diffuse green smoke puff, not a solid acid ball, tentacle, portal, laser beam, sparkling orb or explosion. Faithfully refine only the visible soft smoke texture without inventing new structures or a broad surrounding fog wash. Convert the original black backing and gaps into true transparency, with soft semitransparent smoke edges. One single static cloud, centered with generous transparent padding; no background, creature, weapon, scenery, text, sheet or extra objects.
assets.qa_notes: Petit nuage vert diffus, partie supérieure plus lumineuse et ouvertures dans la partie basse; la disposition générale suit la frame ballsmoke inspectée, avec des volumes et des détails réinterprétés.
